summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by using zip_longest to include dimensions that might be missing in one of the points, filling them with 0. This ensures the distance calculation considers all dimensions.

issues.description: Using zip_longest with fillvalue=0 might lead to incorrect results if points have different dimensions unintentionally. It could be better to raise an error or handle such cases explicitly.
The change introduces a new import (zip_longest) which should be added at the top of the file for consistency with project conventions.
